description: This source file implements time formatting and parsing functions for the Abseil C++ library, including handling of special infinite time values and formatting according to RFC3339 and RFC1123 standards.

methods.name: FormatTime
methods.description: Formats an absl::Time object into a string according to a specified format and timezone.

methods.name: ParseTime
methods.description: Parses a string into an absl::Time object based on a specified format and timezone.

methods.name: AbslParseFlag
methods.description: Parses a string into an absl::Time object for flag support.

methods.name: AbslUnparseFlag
methods.description: Converts an absl::Time object into a string for flag support.

methods.description: Parses a string into an absl::Time object for flag support.
